title: A morphism of affine schemes is a closed immersion exactly when it lifts against every injective ring map
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The criterion converts a surjectivity statement about a ring map into a lifting property against all injective ring maps, and the two directions need different work. Surjective phi gives a lift by the tautological formula s maps to alpha(r) for any r with phi(r) = s, whose well-definedness uses injectivity of psi together with commutativity of the square, followed by the spectrum anti-equivalence. The converse manufactures the test square from phi itself, using the subring phi(R) of S as the test ring, and the existence of the lift forces the inclusion phi(R) -> S to be an isomorphism. The whole content is in choosing the right test ring rather than in executing a standard limit argument. Retained author proof at lines 23509-23544.
